Release notes/v0.14.0/Nov 27, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.14.0.

> The Windows installer is still building and will be added here shortly.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 New

  • Remote desktop from the phone. Open a computer from the Screens row on Home or the screen icon on its heading in Agents. Its screen shows live: tap to click, tap twice for a double click, hold for a right click, hold and move to drag, two fingers to scroll, pinch to zoom (zoomed in, the phone asks for just the part you see, at full sharpness). There's a trackpad mode, a keyboard, sticky ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧, esc, tab and arrows, and on a Mac one tap for Spotlight, Mission Control and the app switcher. It works on the same Wi-Fi and through the relay from anywhere; the top bar says which, with frames per second and delay.
  • Each computer says when a phone is watching. A notification when a session starts, and a banner at the top of the Inbox panel with a Stop button while it runs.
  • You can turn it off. Settings → "Let your phone see and control this computer". Off, the phone is told so and sees nothing.
